title: Noether R340 Paper 32 p226 Brauer beta-exponent source fix
scope: Paper 32, printed/source p.226, Brauer/Noether footnote polynomial.
summary: R340 applies one source-supported German cumulative TeX patch in Paper 32 printed p.226. The Brauer/Noether footnote polynomial changes from `f(\Xi)=\Xi^{2n}+a^2p^2\Xi^2+b^2p^2\beta^2=0` to source-supported `f(\Xi)=\Xi^{2n}+a^2p^2\Xi^2+b^2p^2\beta=0`. The package reports a successful two-pass XeLaTeX build of the 474-page cumulative.
included_evidence: XeLaTeX pass outputs and build log
caveats: This is a one-locus Paper 32 source fix only.
It does not certify Paper 32 as complete or critically edited.
It does not prove Noether corpus closure or multilingual synchronization.
The best staged authority is an IA leaf image, 4061x6010, without embedded DPI; earlier project notes estimate about 400ppi rather than true native650/1000.
High-magnification crops are readability aids from the same raw witness, not independent higher-resolution source images.
